msg: I tried to find a pattern and concentrated on the colour of the gnomes and I could not really find one that i could confidentally tell you. As you only have a short time your instinct is the main thing to focus on. I am not sure if it is a fluke but the yellow gnomes always had mushrooms with a yellow basket, however as you don't know the colour of the basket this is not something you can foresee. The gnomes with the longer hat seemed to pay out more but not on every round I just picked them more due to how many mushrooms I seemed to get.
